findings.message: Studio settings and packages are design intent; application generation has no studio runtime resolver.
"QR browser" needs a template before it can be generated.
"QR application" needs a template before it can be generated.
"QR PostgreSQL" needs a template before it can be generated.
“Manages private QR resources” is a planned relationship; generation is not implemented.
“Persists sessions, links and requests” is a planned relationship; generation is not implemented.

requirements.summary: One HTTP service, one web frontend and separate PostgreSQL; authentication remains inside the cohesive application.
Private QR resources retain a stable public redirect and downloadable image while destinations can change; activity counts requests.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4b application behavior must preserve stable identity/image and distinguish request totals from unique visitors; this studio reference supplies no runtime.

requirements.summary: Reviewed email/password sessions, HttpOnly cookies, logout/expiry, CSRF and server-derived owner identity; no external identity substitution.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4a template binding/verification must preserve the approved session and ownership contracts. Existing accepted legacy support remains separate, unchanged evidence.

requirements.summary: Same-origin proxy, isolated Postgres consumer, public origin /q/{id}, PNG attachment, no-store 302, unknown-ID 404 and bounded UTC activity.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4a must bind and verify the exact preserved source contracts; these finite forms do not author routes or schemas.

requirements.summary: The approved executable legacy design remains supported independently of this new design-only reference.
QR Studio 0.1.0 is an existing experimental recipe with separately pinned implementation and acceptance, not runtime support for studio definitions.
requirements.remainingWork: Retain existing recipe flow and acceptance evidence; do not auto-adopt P35, attach this studio interpretation to its generator, or claim any new build was executed.

requirements.summary: Campaign label/owner filter remains a candidate requiring agreement, not an approved new product requirement.
requirements.remainingWork: Owner approval and an independently verified regeneration/preservation exercise remain separate future work.

requirements.summary: Physical printing/location/map workflow is preserved historical context, excluded from the approved proving milestone; it is not adopted in this reference.
requirements.remainingWork: Do not infer a device deployment, printer transport, label dimensions, location source, offline protocol or capacity commitments. Any revival requires separately agreed requirements.

source.location: What about custom hardware? / Future moves

requirements.summary: Sibling README qualifies QRWTY as a software-generation guinea pig and says custom hardware is not worth exploring.
No billing, custom domains, messaging/Kubernetes/cloud/enterprise rollout, hardware, location, maps or scale result is supplied.
requirements.remainingWork: Retain scope limits. Later runtime field tests must independently verify reproducibility, C4a behavior, C4b preservation, repairs/prompts and failures; do not repair the live project.

requirements.summary: QR-01: Register/login Alice and Bob; create a resource as Alice; record returned ID and persisted destination. Logout invalidates the session. Unauthenticated creation/read/update/image/activity returns 401.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.

requirements.summary: QR-02: Download the real image, record its SHA-256, decode its pixels independently, and assert its URL is the configured public origin plus `/q/{id}`. The destination URL must not be embedded.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.

requirements.summary: QR-03: Request the decoded URL without automatic redirect following, assert 302, no-store, and original Location. Follow it to destination server A and verify A received the request. Assert one event for each redirect request, counting any second request explicitly.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.

requirements.summary: QR-04: Edit destination to server B. Assert identical resource/redirect ID and byte-identical downloaded QR image. Request the original decoded URL again; assert B is reached and A is not. Verify no cached permanent redirect masks the change.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.

requirements.summary: QR-05: Make repeated requests, including from the same client; assert total increases for every redirect request. Fixed test-only clock/data fixtures spanning UTC days verify bucket boundaries, zero days, bounded date range validation, and totals. Do not expose fixture/clock controls in the production app.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.

requirements.summary: QR-06: As Bob, list/read/update/download/activity cannot see Alice's resource; ID guessing and relationship manipulation do not bypass ownership. Lists contain only the current user's resources. Rejected requests do not change destination or scans.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.

requirements.summary: QR-07: Malformed payloads, unknown fields, invalid IDs, non-HTTP URLs, credential-bearing URLs, caller-supplied owner IDs, and missing IDs return documented 400/404 responses. Unknown redirects add no event; failed unauthorized updates preserve the destination.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.

requirements.summary: QR-08: Restart the service and Postgres with the same volumes. Login again, read the saved resource, decode the image again, follow the original URL to B, and verify persisted history plus exactly the new event.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.

requirements.summary: QR-09: Drive account creation/login, resource create/edit, image download, and activity views in the browser by mouse. Check the visible totals agree with API/persisted evidence.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.

requirements.summary: Screen/buttons/Wi-Fi terminal and printer are external boundaries; the server owns authoritative records and validation.

source.location: Operation ID across retries / uncertain output

requirements.summary: Lookup or printing alone must not change stock; stock changes require explicit supported workflow context and separate print outcomes.

requirements.summary: Separate capture/client, application API, data/media and external recognition/data boundaries support a bounded software fixture.
Grocery field review is distinct from dropshipping; shared adapter/media/task/history mechanisms do not combine their products.
Field visits inspect product presence/promotion and prioritize effort using product value/KPI information; current workflow details are background.
requirements.remainingWork: Confirm the first journey and implement visit/task/review/reporting behavior with permitted data; no promised stock counts, priorities or KPI outcomes.
